'''Will Pessetto''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Fort Collins tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] and [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue the Princess (mutated Cloud City mains, Sabacc)]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1712">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territoryd1712/ ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territory], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territoryd1712/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
